TC-19/S27.productIssue: A medication hold dictated before Generate Note & Finish is silently lost if the page reloads (or the app is closed and reopened) before the medication extraction returns, in both care settings. Nursing Home: the physician dictates 'Hold metformin, poor intake.', taps Generate, sees the finished note, and on a reload right then metformin still shows active with no message (EncounterTab.tsx starts 'void extractEncounterMedications()' only after onNext(), i.e. after the note is shown). Hospital: the same with 'Hold the apixaban, procedure tomorrow.' when the reload lands after the note is saved but while the screen still says 'Generating Note…' (useNoteGeneration saves the note, then runs the medication follow-up): apixaban stays active, the course says 'Encounter done', nothing says the hold was not saved. Leaving via the app's own back button is fine in Hospital (the page keeps running). Breaks U22 (UAT 3.5: tap Generate and move on; Empty & Failure States: nothing dictated is lost) and T9.
